adversarial_review.source_evidence_scope: Canonical hashes pin the source files containing the reviewed contracts; they are not a claim that every line of each source file was reviewed.
limits: Targeted semantic review supplements the earlier complete-tree patch-impact screening. It is not a claim that every inherited article is line-by-line proven.
